title: Keep captured items until explicitly saved and allow editing old entries
description:
Newly captured inbox items should remain visible instead of disappearing immediately. Any automatic behavior that hides or removes a fresh item should be disabled by default (or turned off). Give the user an explicit action to save an item, and let them reopen and edit older items.

Acceptance criteria:
- A new capture remains available until the user explicitly saves it.
- The user can reopen and edit previously saved items.
- Immediate disappearance is disabled by default.
notes: Approved design: docs/plans/2026-10-22-explicit-save-design.md. Implementation sequence: add DOM integration coverage for capture blur/focus, explicit save, restart draft recovery, past-day edit/save/cancel and errors; implement capture persistence and inline editing; verify Node/Rust suites and production bundle; review, changelog, commit/push and release. Keep task tracking in Beads.

title: Mark inbox items as processed and record their destination
description: Provide an explicit way to mark an inbox item as processed and record where it went (for example a document, task tracker, project, or link). Preserve that destination so the user can trace a processed item later. Separate feature from explicit saving and editing.
